+@cute.jit
+def gate_warp(
+    cfg,
+    total_tiles,
+    bidx,
+    num_ctas,
+    cu_seqlens,
+    mWorkItems,
+    tidx,
+    mGate,
+    mA,
+    mDt_bias,
+    dt_min,
+    dt_max,
+    sCumsumlog,
+    sBeta,
+    mTransition,
+    sScheduler,
+    bars,
+):
+    """Gate producer (warp 4): the per-chunk dt transform and cumsum tables (cumsumlog[t], beta[t] = dt_t); with
+    ``mTransition`` bound, the tile's log2 decay product per (sequence, head)."""
+
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(cfg.num_regs_other, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.DECREASE)
+    elect_one = nvvm.elect_sync()
+
+    gate_index = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    scheduler_state = PipelineState.start(phase=0)
+
+    lane_idx = tidx % cfg.threads_per_warp
+    n_cols = cfg.b_t // cfg.threads_per_warp
+
+    a = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    bias = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    tile_idx = cutlass.Int32(bidx)
+    while tile_idx < total_tiles:
+        batch_idx, head_idx, batch_start, batch_end, batch_seqlen, batch_num_chunks, write_start, write_end, compute_start, compute_end = decode_work_item(
+            cfg, tile_idx, mWorkItems
+        )
+        head_o, v_offset = decode_head(cfg, head_idx)
+        n_local = write_end - compute_start
+        tile_log2 = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        if n_local > 0:
+            a = mA[head_o].to(cutlass.Float32) * cutlass.Float32(RCP_LN2)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(mDt_bias is not None):
+                bias = mDt_bias[head_o].to(cutlass.Float32)
+            gGateSeq = mGate[None, head_o]
+            for local_idx in cutlass.range(n_local):
+                # ---- dt load + transform: GMEM -> RMEM (OOB neutral: dt = 0) ----------------
+                chunk_idx = compute_start + local_idx
+                chunk_offset = batch_start + chunk_idx * cfg.b_t
+                tokens = [chunk_offset + lane_idx + col * cfg.threads_per_warp for col in range(n_cols)]
+                position_valid = [token < batch_end for token in tokens]
+                dt_values = [gGateSeq[cutlass.min(token, batch_end - 1)].to(cutlass.Float32) + bias for token in tokens]
+                if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.dt_softplus):
+                    for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(n_cols):
+                        dt_values[col] = softplus(dt_values[col])
+                for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(n_cols):
+                    dt_clamped = cutlass.max(cutlass.min(dt_values[col], dt_max), dt_min)
+                    dt_values[col] = dt_clamped if position_valid[col] else cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+                gate_values = [dt_values[col] * a for col in range(n_cols)]
+                for offset in [1, 2, 4, 8, 16]:
+                    for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(n_cols):
+                        n = nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, gate_values[col], offset, 0, kind=nvvm.Shfl.UP)
+                        if lane_idx >= offset:
+                            gate_values[col] = gate_values[col] + n
+                for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, n_cols):
+                    last_v = nvvm.shfl_sync(
+                        0xFFFFFFFF,
+                        gate_values[col - 1],
+                        cfg.threads_per_warp - 1,
+                        cfg.threads_per_warp - 1,
+                        kind=nvvm.Shfl.IDX,
+                    )
+                    gate_values[col] += last_v
+                if cutlass.const_expr(mTransition is not None):
+                    tile_log2 = tile_log2 + nvvm.shfl_sync(
+                        0xFFFFFFFF, gate_values[n_cols - 1], cfg.threads_per_warp - 1, cfg.threads_per_warp - 1, kind=nvvm.Shfl.IDX
+                    )
+
+                gate_idx = gate_index.idx
+                gate_phase = gate_index.phase
+                gate_index = advance(gate_index, cfg.smem_gate_stages)
+                bars.mb_gate_done[gate_idx].wait(gate_phase)
+                for col in cutlass.range_constexpr(n_cols):
+                    position = lane_idx + col * cfg.threads_per_warp
+                    sCumsumlog[position, 0, gate_idx] = gate_values[col]
+                    sBeta[position, 0, gate_idx] = dt_values[col]
+                bars.mb_gate_ready[gate_idx].arrive()
+        if cutlass.const_expr(mTransition is not None):
+            if lane_idx == 0 and write_start == 0 and write_end == batch_num_chunks:
+                mTransition[batch_idx, head_o] = tile_log2.to(mTransition.element_type)
+        tile_idx, scheduler_state = scheduler_next_tile(cfg, bars, sScheduler, scheduler_state, elect_one)
+
+    for _ in range(cfg.smem_gate_stages):
+        bars.mb_gate_done[gate_index.idx].wait(gate_index.phase)
+        gate_index = advance(gate_index, cfg.smem_gate_stages)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def tcgen05_mma_warp(
+    cfg,
+    total_tiles,
+    bidx,
+    num_ctas,
+    cu_seqlens,
+    mWorkItems,
+    tmem_base_slot,
+    sK_trans,
+    sU_trans,
+    sScheduler,
+    bars,
+):
+    """MMA issuer role (warp 6): the state GEMM S += K^T U' of every chunk."""
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(cfg.num_regs_other, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.DECREASE)
+
+    k_index = PipelineState.start(phase=0)
+    u_ready_index = PipelineState.start(phase=0)
+
+    elect_one = nvvm.elect_sync()
+
+    nvvm.tcgen05_alloc(tmem_base_slot, cutlass.Int32(512), group=nvvm.CTAGroup.CTA_1)
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(cfg.tmem_lifecycle_barrier_id, thread_count=cfg.tmem_user_threads)
+
+    # ---- chunk-invariant GEMM descriptor ---------------------------------------------
+    bytes_per_element = cfg.io_dtype.width // 8
+    instruction_descriptor_kv = nvvm.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+        c_dtype=cutlass.Float32,
+        a_dtype=cfg.io_dtype,
+        b_dtype=cfg.io_dtype,
+        n_dim=cfg.d_v,
+        m_dim=cfg.d_k,
+        a_major=1,
+        b_major=1,
+    )
+    bmm_kv_desc = MmaDesc(
+        M=cfg.d_k,
+        N=cfg.d_v,
+        K=cfg.b_t,
+        bpe_a=bytes_per_element,
+        bpe_b=bytes_per_element,
+        tile_k_hw=16,
+        btranspose=True,
+        atranspose=True,
+        cta_group=1,
+        idesc=instruction_descriptor_kv,
+        kind=nvvm.Tcgen05MMAKind.F16,
+    )
+
+    tmem_col = tmem_base_slot.load() & 0xFFFF
+    state_acc_ptr = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_col + cfg.tmem_state_acc_offset, cutlass.Float32)
+    desc_u_trans = desc_opaque(sU_trans[0].desc())
+
+    scheduler_state = PipelineState.start(phase=0)
+    tile_idx = cutlass.Int32(bidx)
+    while tile_idx < total_tiles:
+        batch_idx, head_idx, batch_start, batch_end, batch_seqlen, batch_num_chunks, write_start, write_end, compute_start, compute_end = decode_work_item(
+            cfg, tile_idx, mWorkItems
+        )
+        n_local = write_end - compute_start
+
+        for peel in cutlass.range_constexpr(1 if cfg.use_initial_state else 2):
+            have_state = True if cfg.use_initial_state else peel == 1
+            peel_stop = n_local if cutlass.const_expr(peel == 1 or cfg.use_initial_state) else cutlass.min(n_local, 1)
+            for local_idx in cutlass.range(peel, peel_stop, 1):  # noqa: B007
+                k_idx = k_index.idx
+                bars.mb_k_ready[k_idx].wait(k_index.phase)
+                k_index = advance(k_index, cfg.smem_k_stages)
+                desc_k_trans = desc_opaque(sK_trans[k_idx].desc())
+
+                # ---- S += K^T @ U' -------------------------------------------------------
+                bars.mb_u_ready[0].wait(u_ready_index.phase)
+                u_ready_index = advance(u_ready_index, 1)
+                mma_ss(bmm_kv_desc, desc_k_trans, desc_u_trans, state_acc_ptr, accumulate=have_state)
+                if elect_one:
+                    bars.mb_state_acc_ready[0].arrive(cta_group=1)
+                    bars.mb_u_done[0].arrive(cta_group=1)
+                    bars.mb_k_done[k_idx].arrive(cta_group=1)
+
+        tile_idx, scheduler_state = scheduler_next_tile(cfg, bars, sScheduler, scheduler_state, elect_one)
+
+    bars.mb_tmem_done[0].wait(0)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_relinquish_alloc_permit(group=nvvm.CTAGroup.CTA_1)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_dealloc(
+        nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base_slot.load() & 0xFFFF, cutlass.Int8),
+        cutlass.Int32(512),
+        group=nvvm.CTAGroup.CTA_1,
+    )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def tmaldg_warp(
+    cfg,
+    total_tiles,
+    bidx,
+    num_ctas,
+    cu_seqlens,
+    mWorkItems,
+    sK_raw,
+    sV_raw,
+    tidx,
+    desc_k_base,
+    desc_v_base,
+    mScheduler,
+    sScheduler,
+    bars,
+    k_ratio,
+    v_ratio,
+):
+    """TMA-LDG warp role (warp 5): persistent scheduler loop + per-chunk K / V G->S TMA loads."""
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(cfg.num_regs_other, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.DECREASE)
+
+    k_index = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    v_index = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    scheduler_state = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+
+    elect_one = nvvm.elect_sync()
+    tile_idx = cutlass.Int32(bidx)
+    bytes_per_element = cfg.io_dtype.width // 8
+    box_elements = 128 // bytes_per_element
+    bt = cfg.b_t
+    sK_tma = SmemTile(
+        base=sK_raw,
+        elems_per_stage=cfg.k_cosize // cfg.smem_k_stages,
+        stages=cfg.smem_k_stages,
+        leading_byte_offset=0,
+        stride_byte_offset=0,
+        layout=0,
+        tma_loads_per_tile=cfg.d_k // box_elements,
+        tma_granu_elems=box_elements,
+        tma_subtile_stride_elems=bt * box_elements,
+    )
+    sV_tma = SmemTile(
+        base=sV_raw,
+        elems_per_stage=cfg.v_cosize // cfg.smem_v_stages,
+        stages=cfg.smem_v_stages,
+        leading_byte_offset=0,
+        stride_byte_offset=0,
+        layout=0,
+        tma_loads_per_tile=cfg.d_v // box_elements,
+        tma_granu_elems=box_elements,
+        tma_subtile_stride_elems=bt * box_elements,
+    )
+    desc_qwords = cutlass.Int32(TENSOR_MAP_QWORDS)
+    while tile_idx < total_tiles:
+        batch_idx, head_idx, batch_start, batch_end, batch_seqlen, batch_num_chunks, write_start, write_end, compute_start, compute_end = decode_work_item(
+            cfg, tile_idx, mWorkItems
+        )
+
+        head_o, v_offset = decode_head(cfg, head_idx)
+        head_k = head_idx // k_ratio
+        head_v = head_idx // v_ratio
+        slot = batch_idx * desc_qwords
+        desc_k_slot = (desc_k_base + slot).tospace(cutlass.AddressSpace.generic)
+        desc_v_slot = (desc_v_base + slot).tospace(cutlass.AddressSpace.generic)
+        if elect_one:
+            tma_tensormap_acquire(desc_k_slot)
+            tma_tensormap_acquire(desc_v_slot)
+
+        for chunk_idx in cutlass.range(compute_start, write_end):
+            token_coordinate = chunk_idx * cutlass.Int32(cfg.b_t)
+
+            # ---- K load --------------------------------------------------------------------
+            k_idx = k_index.idx
+            bars.mb_k_done[k_idx].wait(k_index.phase)
+            k_index = advance(k_index, cfg.smem_k_stages)
+            if elect_one:
+                bars.mb_k_ready[k_idx].arrive(n_bytes=cfg.tma_k_bytes)
+            k_slice = tma_slice_runtime_desc(desc_k_slot, cutlass.Int32(0), head_k, token_coordinate)
+            tma_load_tile(sK_tma[k_idx], k_slice, bars.mb_k_ready[k_idx].smem_ptr, acquire=False)
+
+            # ---- V load --------------------------------------------------------------------
+            v_idx = v_index.idx
+            bars.mb_v_done[v_idx].wait(v_index.phase)
+            v_index = advance(v_index, cfg.smem_v_stages)
+            if elect_one:
+                bars.mb_v_ready[v_idx].arrive(n_bytes=cfg.tma_v_bytes)
+            v_slice = tma_slice_runtime_desc(desc_v_slot, v_offset, head_v, token_coordinate)
+            tma_load_tile(sV_tma[v_idx], v_slice, bars.mb_v_ready[v_idx].smem_ptr, acquire=False)
+
+        tile_idx, scheduler_state = scheduler_publish_next(cfg, bars, sScheduler, mScheduler, scheduler_state, num_ctas, elect_one)
+
+    for _ in range(cfg.smem_k_stages):
+        bars.mb_k_done[k_index.idx].wait(k_index.phase)
+        k_index = advance(k_index, cfg.smem_k_stages)
+    for _ in range(cfg.smem_v_stages):
+        bars.mb_v_done[v_index.idx].wait(v_index.phase)
+        v_index = advance(v_index, cfg.smem_v_stages)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(USE_PDL):
+        launch_dependent_grids()
+

+@cute.jit
+def compute1_warp_group(
+    cfg,
+    total_tiles,
+    bidx,
+    num_ctas,
+    cu_seqlens,
+    mWorkItems,
+    tidx,
+    warp_idx,
+    tmem_base_slot,
+    sV_raw,
+    sState_raw,
+    sU_raw,
+    sCumsumlog,
+    sBeta,
+    mState_init,
+    mState_out,
+    mSeedIndices,
+    mFinalIndices,
+    checkpoint_every_n_tokens,
+    sScheduler,
+    bars,
+):
+    """Compute warp-group 1 role (warps 0-3): the state seed, the checkpoint copy, the in-place rescale, the U' build and
+    the final-state store; one state row per thread, one key token per thread in the U' build."""
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(cfg.num_regs_compute_group_1, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+
+    gate_index = PipelineState.start(phase=0)
+    state_acc_index = PipelineState.start(phase=0)
+    u_done_index = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    v_index = PipelineState.start(phase=0)
+
+    num_threads_cg1 = cfg.threads_per_warp * len(cfg.compute_group_1_warp_ids)
+    cg1_tidx = tidx % num_threads_cg1
+    lane_idx = tidx % cfg.threads_per_warp
+    warp_in_group = cg1_tidx // cfg.threads_per_warp
+
+    elect_one = nvvm.elect_sync()
+    bytes_per_element = cfg.io_dtype.width // 8
+    ldtm_width = 32
+    num_ldtms = cutlass.const_expr(cfg.d_v // ldtm_width)
+    vector_width = 16 // bytes_per_element
+    num_vectors = cutlass.const_expr(cfg.d_v // vector_width)
+    words_per_vector = cutlass.const_expr(vector_width // 2)
+    row_swizzle_elements = (cg1_tidx & 7) * vector_width
+    box_elements = 128 // bytes_per_element
+    v_stage_elements = cfg.v_cosize // cfg.smem_v_stages
+    sV_base = sV_raw.data_ptr()
+    sState_base = sState_raw.data_ptr()
+    sU_base = sU_raw.data_ptr()
+    checkpoint_count = cutlass.Int32(0)
+
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync_aligned(cfg.tmem_lifecycle_barrier_id, thread_count=cfg.tmem_user_threads)
+    tmem_base = tmem_base_slot.load()
+    tmem_col = tmem_base & 0xFFFF
+    tmem_row = tmem_base >> 16
+    row_lo_addr = tmem_row << 16
+    row_hi_addr = (tmem_row + 16) << 16
+    tmem_state_col = tmem_col + cfg.tmem_state_acc_offset
+
+    scheduler_state = PipelineState.start(phase=0)
+    tile_idx = cutlass.Int32(bidx)
+    while tile_idx < total_tiles:
+        batch_idx, head_idx, batch_start, batch_end, batch_seqlen, batch_num_chunks, write_start, write_end, compute_start, compute_end = decode_work_item(
+            cfg, tile_idx, mWorkItems
+        )
+        head_o, v_offset = decode_head(cfg, head_idx)
+        seed_row = batch_idx
+        if cutlass.const_expr(mSeedIndices is not None):
+            seed_row = cutlass.Int32(mSeedIndices[batch_idx])
+        n_local = write_end - compute_start
+        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.enable_checkpoints):
+            checkpoint_chunks = checkpoint_every_n_tokens // cutlass.Int32(cfg.b_t)
+            checkpoint_mod = compute_start % checkpoint_chunks
+        if n_local > 0:
+            # ---- state seed: initial state (V-major in GMEM) or zeros -> TMEM -------------
+            if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.use_initial_state):
+                gState_init = mState_init[None, None, head_o, seed_row]
+                seed_state = compute_start == 0
+                if seed_state:
+                    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(num_ldtms):
+                        words = []
+                        for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(ldtm_width):
+                            words.append(gState_init[i * ldtm_width + t + v_offset, cg1_tidx].to(cfg.acc_dtype))
+                        nvvm.tcgen05_st(
+                            "32x32b",
+                            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(row_lo_addr + tmem_state_col + i * ldtm_width, cutlass.Float32),
+                            cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(words), cutlass.Float32),
+                        )
+                    nvvm.tcgen05_wait("store")
+                else:
+                    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(num_ldtms):
+                        nvvm.tcgen05_st(
+                            "32x32b",
+                            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(row_lo_addr + tmem_state_col + i * ldtm_width, cutlass.Float32),
+                            cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(ldtm_width)), cutlass.Float32),
+                        )
+                    nvvm.tcgen05_wait("store")
+
+            for peel in cutlass.range_constexpr(1 if cfg.use_initial_state else 2):
+                have_state = True if cfg.use_initial_state else peel == 1
+                peel_stop = n_local if cutlass.const_expr(peel == 1 or cfg.use_initial_state) else cutlass.min(n_local, 1)
+                for local_idx in cutlass.range(peel, peel_stop, 1):  # noqa: B007
+                    chunk_idx = compute_start + local_idx
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.enable_checkpoints):
+                        do_checkpoint_now = checkpoint_mod == 0
+                        checkpoint_mod = checkpoint_mod + cutlass.Int32(1)
+                        checkpoint_mod = cutlass.Int32(0) if checkpoint_mod == checkpoint_chunks else checkpoint_mod
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.enable_checkpoints and not cfg.use_initial_state):
+                        # ---- checkpoint row 0 = the zero incoming state -----------------------
+                        if chunk_idx == 0 and write_start == 0:
+                            bars.mb_checkpoint_tmastg_done[0].wait((checkpoint_count & cutlass.Int32(1)) ^ cutlass.Int32(1))
+                            checkpoint_zero_ptr = cutlass.inttoptr(sState_base.toint(), cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, cutlass.Int32)
+                            for z in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.d_k * cfg.d_v * bytes_per_element // 4 // num_threads_cg1):
+                                (checkpoint_zero_ptr + cg1_tidx + z * num_threads_cg1).store(cutlass.Int32(0))
+                            nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+                            if elect_one:
+                                bars.mb_checkpoint_tmastg_ready[0].arrive()
+                            checkpoint_count = checkpoint_count + 1
+
+                    gate_idx = gate_index.idx
+                    bars.mb_gate_ready[gate_idx].wait(gate_index.phase)
+                    gate_index = advance(gate_index, cfg.smem_gate_stages)
+                    g_last = sCumsumlog[cfg.b_t - 1, 0, gate_idx]
+
+                    # ---- state epilogue: checkpoint copy, rescale ------------------------------
+                    if cutlass.const_expr(have_state):
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.use_initial_state):
+                            if local_idx > 0:
+                                bars.mb_state_acc_ready[0].wait(state_acc_index.phase)
+                                state_acc_index = advance(state_acc_index, 1)
+                        else:
+                            bars.mb_state_acc_ready[0].wait(state_acc_index.phase)
+                            state_acc_index = advance(state_acc_index, 1)
+                        state_halves = []
+                        for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                            half_addr = row_lo_addr if half == 0 else row_hi_addr
+                            state_halves.append(nvvm.tcgen05_ld("16x256b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(half_addr + tmem_state_col, cutlass.Float32), num=8))
+                        nvvm.tcgen05_wait("load")
+
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.enable_checkpoints):
+                            do_checkpoint = do_checkpoint_now and chunk_idx < write_end
+                            do_checkpoint = do_checkpoint and chunk_idx >= write_start
+                            if do_checkpoint:
+                                bars.mb_checkpoint_tmastg_done[0].wait((checkpoint_count & cutlass.Int32(1)) ^ cutlass.Int32(1))
+                                # ---- S^T bf16 copy (V-major): the checkpoint tile -------------------
+                                matrix = lane_idx // 8
+                                panel_base = (warp_in_group // 2) * (cfg.d_v * box_elements)
+                                for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                                    n_col = (warp_in_group % 2) * 32 + half * 16 + (matrix % 2) * 8
+                                    copy_words = [fp32_to_fp16(state_halves[half][2 * j], state_halves[half][2 * j + 1], dtype=cfg.io_dtype) for j in range(16)]
+                                    for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                                        p_row = (2 * c + matrix // 2) * 8 + lane_idx % 8
+                                        nvvm.stmatrix(
+                                            sState_base + panel_base + p_row * box_elements + swizzle_xor_128b(p_row, n_col),
+                                            [copy_words[4 * c], copy_words[4 * c + 1], copy_words[4 * c + 2], copy_words[4 * c + 3]],
+                                            nvvm.MMALayout.COL,
+                                        )
+                                nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+                                if elect_one:
+                                    bars.mb_checkpoint_tmastg_ready[0].arrive()
+                                checkpoint_count = checkpoint_count + 1
+
+                        gamma = cute.math.exp2(g_last, fastmath=True)
+                        for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                            state_scaled = []
+                            for m in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+                                s0, s1 = fmul2(state_halves[half][2 * m], state_halves[half][2 * m + 1], gamma, gamma)
+                                state_scaled += [s0, s1]
+                            nvvm.tcgen05_st(
+                                "16x256b",
+                                nvvm.make_tmem_ptr((row_lo_addr if half == 0 else row_hi_addr) + tmem_state_col, cutlass.Float32),
+                                cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(state_scaled), cutlass.Float32),
+                            )
+                        nvvm.tcgen05_wait("store")
+
+                    # ---- U' build: U'[j,:] = beta_j exp2(g_127 - g_j) V[j,:] ---------------
+                    v_idx = v_index.idx
+                    bars.mb_v_ready[v_idx].wait(v_index.phase)
+                    v_index = advance(v_index, cfg.smem_v_stages)
+                    bars.mb_u_done[0].wait(u_done_index.phase)
+                    u_done_index = advance(u_done_index, 1)
+                    s_j = sBeta[cg1_tidx, 0, gate_idx] * cute.math.exp2(g_last - sCumsumlog[cg1_tidx, 0, gate_idx], fastmath=True)
+                    v_row_offset = v_idx * v_stage_elements + cg1_tidx * cfg.d_v + row_swizzle_elements
+                    u_row_offset = cg1_tidx * cfg.d_v + row_swizzle_elements
+                    for q in cutlass.range_constexpr(num_vectors):
+                        slot = q * vector_width
+                        v_words = (sV_base + (v_row_offset ^ slot)).load(count=vector_width, alignment=16).bitcast(cutlass.Int32)
+                        words = []
+                        for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(words_per_vector):
+                            v_lo, v_hi = f16x2_to_f32(v_words[w], dtype=cfg.io_dtype)
+                            u0, u1 = fmul2(v_lo, v_hi, s_j, s_j)
+                            words.append(fp32_to_fp16(u0, u1, dtype=cfg.io_dtype))
+                        (sU_base + (u_row_offset ^ slot)).store(cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(words), cutlass.Int32).bitcast(cfg.io_dtype), alignment=16)
+                    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+                    bars.mb_u_ready[0].arrive()
+                    bars.mb_v_done[v_idx].arrive()
+                    bars.mb_gate_done[gate_idx].arrive()
+
+        # ---- final state store: TMEM -> GMEM (V-major); every item is its own row ---------
+        if n_local > 0:
+            bars.mb_state_acc_ready[0].wait(state_acc_index.phase)
+            state_acc_index = advance(state_acc_index, 1)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.store_final_state):
+                final_row = batch_idx
+                if cutlass.const_expr(mFinalIndices is not None):
+                    final_row = cutlass.Int32(mFinalIndices[batch_idx])
+                gState_out = mState_out[None, None, head_o, final_row]
+                for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(num_ldtms):
+                    state_vector = nvvm.tcgen05_ld("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(row_lo_addr + tmem_state_col + i * ldtm_width, cutlass.Float32), num=32)
+                    nvvm.tcgen05_wait("load")
+                    for t in cutlass.range_constexpr(ldtm_width):
+                        gState_out[i * ldtm_width + t + v_offset, cg1_tidx] = state_vector[t].to(mState_out.element_type)
+        else:
+            if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.store_final_state):
+                final_row = batch_idx
+                if cutlass.const_expr(mFinalIndices is not None):
+                    final_row = cutlass.Int32(mFinalIndices[batch_idx])
+                gState_out = mState_out[None, None, head_o, final_row]
+                if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.use_initial_state):
+                    gState_in = mState_init[None, None, head_o, seed_row]
+                    for p in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.d_v):
+                        seed_value = gState_in[p + v_offset, cg1_tidx]
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(mState_init.element_type != mState_out.element_type):
+                            seed_value = seed_value.to(mState_out.element_type)
+                        gState_out[p + v_offset, cg1_tidx] = seed_value
+                else:
+                    for p in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.d_v):
+                        gState_out[p + v_offset, cg1_tidx] = cutlass.Float32(0.0).to(mState_out.element_type)
+
+        tile_idx, scheduler_state = scheduler_next_tile(cfg, bars, sScheduler, scheduler_state, elect_one)
+
+    bars.mb_tmem_done[0].arrive()
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.enable_checkpoints):
+        bars.mb_checkpoint_tmastg_done[0].wait((checkpoint_count & cutlass.Int32(1)) ^ cutlass.Int32(1))
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def frost_mamba2_recompute(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    desc_k_array: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    desc_v_array: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    desc_checkpoint_array: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    k_ratio: cute.FastDivmodDivisorV2,
+    v_ratio: cute.FastDivmodDivisorV2,
+    mGate: cute.Tensor,
+    mA: cute.Tensor,
+    mDt_bias: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    cu_seqlens: cute.Tensor,
+    mState_init: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mState_out: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mSeedIndices: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mFinalIndices: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mWorkItems: cute.Tensor,
+    mCount: cute.Tensor,
+    mScheduler: cute.Tensor,
+    mTransition: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    checkpoint_every_n_tokens: cutlass.Int32,
+    dt_min: cutlass.Float32,
+    dt_max: cutlass.Float32,
+    cumsumlog_smem_layout_staged: cute.Layout,
+    beta_smem_layout_staged: cute.Layout,
+    tensormap_workspace: cute.Tensor,
+    n_desc: cutlass.Int32,
+):
+    """Mamba-2 recompute kernel: warp-specialized persistent tile loop over the state chain alone.  The descriptor array
+    indices select K, V and the checkpoints inside ``tensormap_workspace``: (0, 1, 2) for this module's own prologue,
+    the prefill's positions when the chain shares its arrays."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(USE_PDL):
+        wait_on_dependent_grids()
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx())
+    bidx = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+    num_ctas = cute.arch.grid_dim()[0]
+
+    total_tiles = mCount[0]
+
+    desc_base_words = tensormap_workspace.iterator.raw_ptr()
+    desc_qwords = cutlass.Int32(TENSOR_MAP_QWORDS)
+    arr_words = n_desc * desc_qwords
+    desc_k_base = desc_base_words + cutlass.Int32(desc_k_array) * arr_words
+    desc_v_base = desc_base_words + cutlass.Int32(desc_v_array) * arr_words
+    desc_checkpoint_base = desc_base_words + cutlass.Int32(desc_checkpoint_array) * arr_words
+
+    SMEM = cutlass.AddressSpace.smem
+
+    SWIZZLE_LAYOUT = 2
+    LEAD = 16
+    STRIDE = 8 * 128
+    KT_LEAD = cfg.b_t * 128
+    V_LEAD = cfg.b_t * 128
+    sK_raw = cutlass.Array(
+        cfg.io_dtype,
+        cfg.k_cosize,
+        space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem,
+        alignment=cfg.buffer_align_bytes,
+    )
+    sK_trans = SmemTile(
+        base=sK_raw.data_ptr(),
+        elems_per_stage=(cfg.k_cosize // cfg.smem_k_stages),
+        stages=cfg.smem_k_stages,
+        leading_byte_offset=KT_LEAD,
+        stride_byte_offset=STRIDE,
+        layout=SWIZZLE_LAYOUT,
+    )
+    sV_raw = cutlass.Array(
+        cfg.io_dtype,
+        cfg.v_cosize,
+        space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem,
+        alignment=cfg.buffer_align_bytes,
+    )
+    sState_raw = cutlass.Array(
+        cfg.io_dtype,
+        cfg.state_cosize,
+        space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem,
+        alignment=cfg.buffer_align_bytes,
+    )
+    sU_raw = cutlass.Array(
+        cfg.io_dtype,
+        cfg.u_cosize,
+        space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem,
+        alignment=cfg.buffer_align_bytes,
+    )
+    sU_trans = SmemTile(
+        base=sU_raw.data_ptr(),
+        elems_per_stage=cfg.u_cosize,
+        stages=1,
+        leading_byte_offset=V_LEAD,
+        stride_byte_offset=STRIDE,
+        layout=SWIZZLE_LAYOUT,
+    )
+    bars = make_bars(cfg)
+    tmem_base_slot = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int32, 1, space=SMEM, alignment=16)
+    sScheduler = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int32, cfg.scheduler_stages, space=SMEM, alignment=16)
+    cumsumlog_raw = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, cute.cosize(cumsumlog_smem_layout_staged), space=SMEM, alignment=128)
+    beta_raw = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, cute.cosize(beta_smem_layout_staged), space=SMEM, alignment=128)
+    sCumsumlog = cute.make_tensor(
+        cute.make_ptr(cutlass.Float32, cumsumlog_raw.data_ptr().toint(), mem_space=cute.AddressSpace.smem, assumed_align=128),
+        cumsumlog_smem_layout_staged,
+    )
+    sBeta = cute.make_tensor(
+        cute.make_ptr(cutlass.Float32, beta_raw.data_ptr().toint(), mem_space=cute.AddressSpace.smem, assumed_align=128),
+        beta_smem_layout_staged,
+    )
+
+    # ---- mbarrier init (all threads) -------------------------------------------------
+    for s in range(cfg.smem_k_stages):
+        bars.mb_k_ready[s].init()
+        bars.mb_k_done[s].init()
+    for s in range(cfg.smem_v_stages):
+        bars.mb_v_ready[s].init()
+        bars.mb_v_done[s].init()
+    for s in range(cfg.smem_gate_stages):
+        bars.mb_gate_ready[s].init()
+        bars.mb_gate_done[s].init()
+    for b in (
+        bars.mb_state_acc_ready,
+        bars.mb_u_ready,
+        bars.mb_u_done,
+        bars.mb_checkpoint_tmastg_ready,
+        bars.mb_checkpoint_tmastg_done,
+        bars.mb_tmem_done,
+    ):
+        b[0].init()
+    for s in range(cfg.scheduler_stages):
+        bars.mb_scheduler_ready[s].init()
+        bars.mb_scheduler_done[s].init()
+
+    nvvm.fence_mbarrier_init()
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync()
+
+    # ---- warp specialization ---------------------------------------------------------
+    if warp_idx >= cfg.compute_group_1_warp_ids[0] and warp_idx <= cfg.compute_group_1_warp_ids[-1]:
+        compute1_warp_group(
+            cfg,
+            total_tiles,
+            bidx,
+            num_ctas,
+            cu_seqlens,
+            mWorkItems,
+            tidx,
+            warp_idx=warp_idx,
+            tmem_base_slot=tmem_base_slot,
+            sV_raw=sV_raw,
+            sState_raw=sState_raw,
+            sU_raw=sU_raw,
+            sCumsumlog=sCumsumlog,
+            sBeta=sBeta,
+            mState_init=mState_init,
+            mState_out=mState_out,
+            mSeedIndices=mSeedIndices,
+            mFinalIndices=mFinalIndices,
+            checkpoint_every_n_tokens=checkpoint_every_n_tokens,
+            sScheduler=sScheduler,
+            bars=bars,
+        )
+    elif warp_idx == cfg.load_gate_warp_id:
+        gate_warp(
+            cfg,
+            total_tiles,
+            bidx,
+            num_ctas,
+            cu_seqlens,
+            mWorkItems,
+            tidx,
+            mGate=mGate,
+            mA=mA,
+            mDt_bias=mDt_bias,
+            dt_min=dt_min,
+            dt_max=dt_max,
+            sCumsumlog=sCumsumlog,
+            sBeta=sBeta,
+            mTransition=mTransition,
+            sScheduler=sScheduler,
+            bars=bars,
+        )
+    elif warp_idx == cfg.tcgen05_mma_warp_id:
+        tcgen05_mma_warp(
+            cfg,
+            total_tiles,
+            bidx,
+            num_ctas,
+            cu_seqlens,
+            mWorkItems,
+            tmem_base_slot=tmem_base_slot,
+            sK_trans=sK_trans,
+            sU_trans=sU_trans,
+            sScheduler=sScheduler,
+            bars=bars,
+        )
+    elif warp_idx == cfg.tma_kv_warp_id:
+        tmaldg_warp(
+            cfg,
+            total_tiles,
+            bidx,
+            num_ctas,
+            cu_seqlens,
+            mWorkItems,
+            sK_raw=sK_raw,
+            sV_raw=sV_raw,
+            tidx=tidx,
+            desc_k_base=desc_k_base,
+            desc_v_base=desc_v_base,
+            mScheduler=mScheduler,
+            sScheduler=sScheduler,
+            bars=bars,
+            k_ratio=k_ratio,
+            v_ratio=v_ratio,
+        )
+    elif warp_idx == cfg.epilogue_warp_id:
+        tmastg_warp(
+            cfg,
+            total_tiles,
+            bidx,
+            num_ctas,
+            cu_seqlens,
+            mWorkItems,
+            checkpoint_every_n_tokens,
+            tidx,
+            sState_raw=sState_raw,
+            desc_checkpoint_base=desc_checkpoint_base,
+            sScheduler=sScheduler,
+            bars=bars,
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Mamba2RecomputeCfg:
+    """Static configuration of one compiled Mamba-2 recompute kernel.
+
+    The per-compile parameters (dtypes, the state ports, checkpoints) are the ``cute.compile`` cache keys; the rest is
+    derived from the module-global ``CFG`` constants.  ``host`` stamps the shape-derived fields at trace time.  Passed
+    ``cfg``-first (a ``cutlass.Constexpr``) into ``host`` / ``kernel`` and every warp body.
+    """
+
+    io_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric]
+    acc_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric]
+    state_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric]
+    max_active_clusters: int
+    use_initial_state: bool
+    store_final_state: bool
+    enable_checkpoints: bool
+    d_k: int
+    d_v: int
+    dt_softplus: bool = True
+    tiles_per_head: int = 1
+    scheduler_stages: int = CFG.SMEM_SCHEDULER_STAGES
+
+    # ---- fixed constants stamped from CFG at build time ------------------------------
+    b_t: int = CFG.B_T
+    expand_num: int = 1
+    compute_group_1_warp_ids: Tuple[int, ...] = CFG.COMPUTE_GROUP_1_WARP_IDS
+    load_gate_warp_id: int = CFG.LOAD_GATE_WARP_ID
+    tma_kv_warp_id: int = CFG.TMA_KV_WARP_ID
+    tcgen05_mma_warp_id: int = CFG.TCGEN05_MMA_WARP_ID
+    epilogue_warp_id: int = CFG.EPILOGUE_WARP_ID
+    num_regs_compute_group_1: int = CFG.NUM_REGS_COMPUTE_GROUP_1
+    num_regs_other: int = CFG.NUM_REGS_OTHER
+    threads_per_warp: int = CFG.THREADS_PER_WARP
+    threads_per_cta: int = 0
+    cluster_shape_mnk: Tuple[int, int, int] = CFG.CLUSTER_SHAPE_MNK
+
+    # ---- named barrier slots (ids 1-4; 0 is the CTA-wide sync) -----------------------
+    tmem_lifecycle_barrier_id: int = 1
+    tmem_user_threads: int = 0
+
+    # ---- SMEM / TMEM stage counts + TMEM column offsets ------------------------------
+    smem_k_stages: int = CFG.SMEM_K_STAGES
+    smem_v_stages: int = CFG.SMEM_V_STAGES
+    smem_state_stages: int = CFG.SMEM_STATE_STAGES
+    smem_u_stages: int = CFG.SMEM_U_STAGES
+    smem_gate_stages: int = CFG.SMEM_GATE_STAGES
+    tmem_state_acc_stages: int = CFG.TMEM_STATE_ACC_STAGES
+    tmem_state_acc_offset: int = 0
+    buffer_align_bytes: int = CFG.BUFFER_ALIGN_BYTES
+
+    # ---- stamped by host at trace time (shape-derived) -------------------------------
+    k_cosize: int = 0
+    v_cosize: int = 0
+    state_cosize: int = 0
+    u_cosize: int = 0
+    tma_k_bytes: int = 0
+    tma_v_bytes: int = 0
+
+
+def build_cfg(
+    io_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric],
+    state_dtype: Type[cutlass.Numeric],
+    *,
+    max_active_clusters: int,
+    use_initial_state: bool,
+    store_final_state: bool = True,
+    enable_checkpoints: bool = False,
+    dt_softplus: bool = True,
+    d_k: int,
+    d_v: int,
+) -> Mamba2RecomputeCfg:
+    """Build the per-compile ``Mamba2RecomputeCfg`` (io_dtype in {Float16, BFloat16}; acc is always Float32)."""
+    cfg = Mamba2RecomputeCfg(
+        io_dtype=io_dtype,
+        acc_dtype=cutlass.Float32,
+        state_dtype=state_dtype,
+        max_active_clusters=max_active_clusters,
+        use_initial_state=use_initial_state,
+        store_final_state=store_final_state,
+        enable_checkpoints=enable_checkpoints,
+        dt_softplus=dt_softplus,
+        d_k=d_k,
+        d_v=d_v,
+    )
+    n_cg1 = len(cfg.compute_group_1_warp_ids)
+    cfg.threads_per_cta = cfg.threads_per_warp * (4 + n_cg1)
+    cfg.tmem_user_threads = cfg.threads_per_warp * (1 + n_cg1)
+    cfg.tmem_state_acc_offset = 0
+    return cfg
+

+TENSORMAP_DESC_ARRAYS = 3  # per-batch runtime TMA descriptors: K, V, checkpoints
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def build_descs_body(
+    widx,
+    base_k,
+    base_v,
+    base_checkpoint,
+    desc_workspace: cute.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: cute.Tensor,
+    k: cute.Tensor,
+    v: cute.Tensor,
+    state_checkpoints_out: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    n_batch: cutlass.Int32,
+    checkpoint_every_n: cutlass.Int32,
+    b_t: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+) -> None:
+    """Per-batch descriptor-array build, one warp per array, inside the prologue kernel after its order pass."""
+    arr_words = n_batch * cutlass.Int32(TENSOR_MAP_QWORDS)
+    sub0 = cute.make_tensor(desc_workspace.iterator, cute.make_layout((arr_words,), stride=(1,)))
+    sub1 = cute.make_tensor(desc_workspace.iterator + arr_words, cute.make_layout((arr_words,), stride=(1,)))
+    sub2 = cute.make_tensor(desc_workspace.iterator + 2 * arr_words, cute.make_layout((arr_words,), stride=(1,)))
+
+    if widx == 0:
+        emit_seq_descs(base_k, sub0, cu_seqlens, k, n_batch, 2, lanes=32)
+        nvvm.fence_proxy_release(nvvm.MemScope.GPU, from_proxy=nvvm.Proxy.GENERIC, to_proxy=nvvm.Proxy.TENSORMAP)
+    if widx == 1:
+        emit_seq_descs(base_v, sub1, cu_seqlens, v, n_batch, 2, lanes=32)
+        nvvm.fence_proxy_release(nvvm.MemScope.GPU, from_proxy=nvvm.Proxy.GENERIC, to_proxy=nvvm.Proxy.TENSORMAP)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(state_checkpoints_out is not None):
+        if widx == 2:
+            emit_checkpoint_seq_descs(base_checkpoint, sub2, cu_seqlens, state_checkpoints_out, n_batch, checkpoint_every_n, 2, lanes=32)
+            nvvm.fence_proxy_release(nvvm.MemScope.GPU, from_proxy=nvvm.Proxy.GENERIC, to_proxy=nvvm.Proxy.TENSORMAP)
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def frost_mamba2_recompute_prologue(
+    order_gen: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    b_t: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    base_k: cutlass.GridConstant[tma.TensorMap],
+    base_v: cutlass.GridConstant[tma.TensorMap],
+    base_checkpoint: cutlass.GridConstant[tma.TensorMap],
+    desc_workspace: cute.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: cute.Tensor,
+    k: cute.Tensor,
+    v: cute.Tensor,
+    state_checkpoints_out: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mStaging: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    mCount: cute.Tensor,
+    mWorkItems: cute.Tensor,
+    mScheduler: cute.Tensor,
+    n_batch: cutlass.Int32,
+    checkpoint_every_n: cutlass.Int32,
+) -> None:
+    """Two-CTA prologue: block 0 LPT-orders the work-item table and zeroes the scheduler rings via
+    :func:`order_body`, block 1 builds the per-batch TMA-descriptor arrays via :func:`build_descs_body`,
+    one warp per array."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(USE_PDL):
+        wait_on_dependent_grids()
+        launch_dependent_grids()
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    tidx = cutlass.Int32(tidx)
+    widx = tidx // cutlass.Int32(32)
+    bidx = cutlass.Int32(cute.arch.block_idx()[0])
+    if bidx == cutlass.Int32(0):
+        sKey = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int32, ORDER_CAPACITY, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=16)
+        sIdx = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int32, ORDER_CAPACITY, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=16)
+        sSpread = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int32, 2, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=8)
+        n_heads_out = cutlass.Int32(k.shape[1] if k.shape[1] >= v.shape[1] else v.shape[1])
+        order_body(
+            order_gen,
+            b_t,
+            ORDER_THREADS,
+            ORDER_ELEMENTS,
+            tidx,
+            n_heads_out,
+            n_heads_out * n_batch,
+            cu_seqlens,
+            mStaging,
+            mCount,
+            mWorkItems,
+            mScheduler,
+            sKey,
+            sIdx,
+            sSpread,
+        )
+    else:
+        build_descs_body(
+            widx,
+            base_k,
+            base_v,
+            base_checkpoint,
+            desc_workspace,
+            cu_seqlens,
+            k,
+            v,
+            state_checkpoints_out,
+            n_batch,
+            checkpoint_every_n,
+            b_t,
+        )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def base_descriptors(io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, b_t: cutlass.Constexpr[int], k: cute.Tensor, v: cute.Tensor, state_checkpoints_out: Optional[cute.Tensor]):
+    """The whole-tensor TMA descriptors (K, V, checkpoints) the prologue's per-batch arrays are built from."""
+    h_k = k.shape[1]
+    h_v = v.shape[1]
+    heads_out = h_k if h_k >= h_v else h_v
+    d_v = v.shape[2]
+    bytes_per_element = io_dtype.width // 8
+    box_elements = 128 // bytes_per_element
+    bt = b_t
+
+    k_row_stride, k_head_stride = k.stride[0], k.stride[1]
+    v_row_stride, v_head_stride = v.stride[0], v.stride[1]
+
+    seqlen = k.shape[0]
+    d_k = k.shape[2]
+    k_headed = cute.make_tensor(k.iterator, cute.make_layout((seqlen, h_k, d_k), stride=(k_row_stride, k_head_stride, 1)))
+    v_headed = cute.make_tensor(v.iterator, cute.make_layout((d_v, h_v, seqlen), stride=(1, v_head_stride, v_row_stride)))
+    swizzle_128b = tma.TensorMapSwizzle.s128b
+    base_desc_k = tma.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(k_headed, box_dims=(bt, 1, box_elements), stride_order=(2, 1, 0), swizzle=swizzle_128b)
+    base_desc_v = tma.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(v_headed, box_dims=(box_elements, 1, bt), stride_order=(0, 1, 2), swizzle=swizzle_128b)
+
+    base_desc_checkpoint = base_desc_v
+    if cutlass.const_expr(state_checkpoints_out is not None):
+        d_v_state = state_checkpoints_out.shape[2]
+        d_k_state = state_checkpoints_out.shape[3]
+        checkpoint_box_elements = 128 // (state_checkpoints_out.element_type.width // 8)
+        checkpoint_view = cute.make_tensor(
+            state_checkpoints_out.iterator,
+            cute.make_layout(
+                (d_k_state, d_v_state, state_checkpoints_out.shape[0], heads_out),
+                stride=(state_checkpoints_out.stride[3], state_checkpoints_out.stride[2], state_checkpoints_out.stride[0], state_checkpoints_out.stride[1]),
+            ),
+        )
+        base_desc_checkpoint = tma.create_tensor_map_tiled_from_view(
+            checkpoint_view, box_dims=(checkpoint_box_elements, d_v_state, 1, 1), stride_order=(0, 1, 2, 3), swizzle=swizzle_128b
+        )
+    return base_desc_k, base_desc_v, base_desc_checkpoint
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def prologue(
+    io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    b_t: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    order_gen: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    k: cute.Tensor,
+    v: cute.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: cute.Tensor,
+    state_checkpoints_out: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    work_item_staging: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    work_count: cute.Tensor,
+    work_items: cute.Tensor,
+    scheduler_counter: cute.Tensor,
+    checkpoint_every_n: cutlass.Int32,
+    tensormap_workspace: cute.Tensor,
+    stream: cuda.CUstream,
+):
+    """One-launch prologue: LPT-order the work items and build the per-(b,h) TMA-descriptor arrays (K, V, checkpoints)
+    into ``tensormap_workspace``."""
+    batch_size = cu_seqlens.shape[0] - 1
+    base_desc_k, base_desc_v, base_desc_checkpoint = base_descriptors(io_dtype, b_t, k, v, state_checkpoints_out)
+    frost_mamba2_recompute_prologue(
+        order_gen,
+        b_t,
+        base_desc_k,
+        base_desc_v,
+        base_desc_checkpoint,
+        tensormap_workspace,
+        cu_seqlens,
+        k,
+        v,
+        state_checkpoints_out,
+        work_item_staging,
+        work_count,
+        work_items,
+        scheduler_counter,
+        cutlass.Int32(batch_size),
+        checkpoint_every_n,
+    ).launch(grid=(2, 1, 1), block=(ORDER_THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream, use_pdl=USE_PDL)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def host(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    desc_k_array: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    desc_v_array: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    desc_checkpoint_array: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    k: cute.Tensor,
+    v: cute.Tensor,
+    gate: cute.Tensor,
+    a: cute.Tensor,
+    dt_bias: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    cu_seqlens: cute.Tensor,
+    state_in: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    state_out: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    seed_indices: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    final_indices: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    work_items: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    work_count: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    scheduler_counter: cute.Tensor,
+    transition: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    checkpoint_every_n_tokens: cutlass.Int32,
+    dt_min: cutlass.Float32,
+    dt_max: cutlass.Float32,
+    tensormap_workspace: cute.Tensor,
+    stream: cuda.CUstream,
+):
+    batch_size = cu_seqlens.shape[0] - 1
+    heads_out = cutlass.Int32(gate.shape[1])
+    k_ratio = cute.FastDivmodDivisorV2(heads_out // cutlass.Int32(k.shape[1]))
+    v_ratio = cute.FastDivmodDivisorV2(heads_out // cutlass.Int32(v.shape[1]))
+
+    # ---- head-major views: (V, K, heads, seqs) states --------------------------------
+    if cutlass.const_expr(state_in is not None):
+        state_in = cute.make_tensor(
+            state_in.iterator,
+            cute.make_layout(
+                (state_in.shape[2], state_in.shape[3], state_in.shape[1], state_in.shape[0]),
+                stride=(state_in.stride[2], state_in.stride[3], state_in.stride[1], state_in.stride[0]),
+            ),
+        )
+    if cutlass.const_expr(state_out is not None):
+        state_out = cute.make_tensor(
+            state_out.iterator,
+            cute.make_layout(
+                (state_out.shape[2], state_out.shape[3], state_out.shape[1], state_out.shape[0]),
+                stride=(state_out.stride[2], state_out.stride[3], state_out.stride[1], state_out.stride[0]),
+            ),
+        )
+
+    # ---- SMEM sizing: per-buffer element cosizes -------------------------------------
+    bytes_per_element = cfg.io_dtype.width // 8
+    k_tile_elements = cfg.b_t * cfg.d_k
+    v_tile_elements = cfg.d_v * cfg.b_t
+    cfg.k_cosize = k_tile_elements * cfg.smem_k_stages
+    cfg.v_cosize = v_tile_elements * cfg.smem_v_stages
+    cfg.state_cosize = cfg.d_k * cfg.d_v
+    cfg.u_cosize = v_tile_elements
+
+    cumsumlog_smem_layout_staged = cute.make_layout((cfg.b_t, 1, cfg.smem_gate_stages))
+    beta_smem_layout_staged = cute.make_layout((cfg.b_t, 1, cfg.smem_gate_stages))
+
+    cfg.tma_k_bytes = k_tile_elements * bytes_per_element
+    cfg.tma_v_bytes = v_tile_elements * bytes_per_element
+
+    num_descs = batch_size
+
+    # ---- launch ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+    grid_shape = (cfg.max_active_clusters, 1, 1)
+
+    frost_mamba2_recompute(
+        cfg,
+        desc_k_array,
+        desc_v_array,
+        desc_checkpoint_array,
+        k_ratio,
+        v_ratio,
+        gate,
+        a,
+        dt_bias,
+        cu_seqlens,
+        state_in,
+        state_out,
+        seed_indices,
+        final_indices,
+        work_items,
+        work_count,
+        scheduler_counter,
+        transition,
+        checkpoint_every_n_tokens,
+        dt_min,
+        dt_max,
+        cumsumlog_smem_layout_staged,
+        beta_smem_layout_staged,
+        tensormap_workspace,
+        cutlass.Int32(num_descs),
+    ).launch(
+        grid=grid_shape,
+        block=(cfg.threads_per_cta, 1, 1),
+        cluster=cfg.cluster_shape_mnk,
+        stream=stream,
+        use_pdl=USE_PDL,
+        min_blocks_per_mp=1,
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+frost_mamba2_recompute_prologue.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=False)
+frost_mamba2_recompute.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=False)

+"""One compiled launch for the Mamba-2 warmup and uncut backwards: the split-K table (plan, scan and walk, warmup
+only), the bprop prologue and the bprop issued from a single host, the way ``split_k.launch`` already sequences its
+three kernels, and the backward summary (its prologue and the summary kernel) the same way.  The checkpoint series the
+bprop reads is the forward's own or the one the engine regenerates with the recompute kernel ahead of this launch.  Every kernel, its host and the tensor placeholder each host was compiled with are the
+standalone modules' own; this host only sequences the launches.  The decay-warmup table reads the Mamba-2 gate through
+the GDN safe-gate transform (raw dt gate, ``a`` (A), ``dt_bias``), the same per-token decay the kernel's gate
+warp builds."""
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import from_dlpack
+
+import cutlass.experimental.cuda.tensor_map as tma
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.barrier import launch_dependent_grids, wait_on_dependent_grids
+
+from ..common import split_k
+from ..common.host import get_dtype
+from ..common.gate_bwd import exit_slot_table_body
+from ..common.split_k import ORDER_CAPACITY, ORDER_ELEMENTS, ORDER_THREADS, order_body
+from . import mamba2_bprop_f16, mamba2_bprop_summary_f16, mamba2_recompute_f16
+
+USE_PDL = True
+warmup_backward_cache = {}
+regenerate_backward_cache = {}
+summary_backward_cache = {}
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def warmup_backward_host(
+    split: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    b_t: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    overhead_chunks: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    warmup_cap: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    n_heads_out: cutlass.Int32,
+    num_sms: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    io_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    order_gen: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    bprop_cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    n_tiles: cutlass.Int32,
+    ideal_chunks: cutlass.Int32,
+    batch_size: cutlass.Int32,
+    log2_thresh: cutlass.Float32,
+    n_scan_ctas: cutlass.Int32,
+    n_walk_ctas: cutlass.Int32,
+    dt_min: cutlass.Float32,
+    dt_max: cutlass.Float32,
+    q: cute.Tensor,
+    k: cute.Tensor,
+    v: cute.Tensor,
+    do: cute.Tensor,
+    gate: cute.Tensor,
+    gate_table: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    a: cute.Tensor,
+    a_table: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    dt_bias: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    dt_bias_table: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    d: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    dq: cute.Tensor,
+    dk: cute.Tensor,
+    dv: cute.Tensor,
+    checkpoints: cute.Tensor,
+    exit_dots: cute.Tensor,
+    skip_bwd_part: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    cu_seqlens: cute.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens_table: cute.Tensor,
+    dstate_in: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    dstate0: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    work_items: cute.Tensor,
+    work_items_table: cute.Tensor,
+    work_count: cute.Tensor,
+    work_count_table: cute.Tensor,
+    staging: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    item_scratch: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    chunk_scratch: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    scheduler: cute.Tensor,
+    transition: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    workspace: cute.Tensor,
+    exit_slots: cute.Tensor,
+    stream: cuda.CUstream,
+) -> None:
+    if cutlass.const_expr(split):
+        split_k.launch(
+            split,
+            b_t,
+            True,
+            True,
+            False,
+            overhead_chunks,
+            1,
+            warmup_cap,
+            n_heads_out,
+            num_sms,
+            n_tiles,
+            ideal_chunks,
+            batch_size,
+            log2_thresh,
+            gate_table,
+            a_table,
+            dt_bias_table,
+            cu_seqlens_table,
+            chunk_scratch,
+            item_scratch,
+            work_items_table,
+            work_count_table,
+            scheduler,
+            n_scan_ctas,
+            n_walk_ctas,
+            stream,
+        )
+    mamba2_bprop_f16.prologue(
+        io_dtype,
+        b_t,
+        order_gen,
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        do,
+        dq,
+        dk,
+        dv,
+        cu_seqlens,
+        checkpoints,
+        staging,
+        work_count,
+        work_items,
+        scheduler,
+        workspace,
+        exit_slots,
+        stream,
+    )
+    mamba2_bprop_f16.host(
+        bprop_cfg,
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        do,
+        gate,
+        a,
+        dt_bias,
+        d,
+        dq,
+        dk,
+        dv,
+        checkpoints,
+        exit_dots,
+        skip_bwd_part,
+        cu_seqlens,
+        dstate_in,
+        dstate0,
+        work_items,
+        work_count,
+        scheduler,
+        transition,
+        dt_min,
+        dt_max,
+        workspace,
+        stream,
+    )
+
+
+def build_warmup_backward(
+    *,
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    do,
+    gate,
+    a,
+    dt_bias,
+    d,
+    dq,
+    dk,
+    dv,
+    checkpoints,
+    exit_dots,
+    skip_bwd_part,
+    cu_seqlens,
+    dstate_in,
+    dstate0,
+    work_items,
+    work_count,
+    item_scratch,
+    chunk_scratch,
+    scheduler,
+    workspace,
+    exit_slots,
+    split,
+    n_tiles,
+    ideal_chunks,
+    num_sm,
+    b_t,
+    dt_softplus,
+    dt_min,
+    dt_max,
+    device,
+    stream,
+    transition=None,
+):
+    """Compile (cached per static config) the warmup or uncut backward launch over the buffers of one plan."""
+    _HQ, DK = q.shape[1], q.shape[2]
+    _HV, DV = do.shape[1], do.shape[2]
+    facts = split_k.split_table_facts(
+        gate,
+        cu_seqlens,
+        split=split,
+        n_tiles=n_tiles,
+        ideal_chunks=ideal_chunks,
+        num_sms=num_sm,
+        b_t=b_t,
+        log2_threshold=None,
+        log_gate=True,
+        safe_gate=True,
+        expand_num=1,
+    )
+    io_dtype = get_dtype(q.dtype)
+    state_source = dstate_in if dstate_in is not None else dstate0
+    state_dtype = get_dtype(state_source.dtype) if state_source is not None else cutlass.Float32
+    key = (
+        str(q.dtype),
+        str(gate.dtype),
+        str(a.dtype),
+        str(dt_bias.dtype) if dt_bias is not None else "none",
+        str(d.dtype) if d is not None else "none",
+        len(d.shape) if d is not None else 0,
+        str(cu_seqlens.dtype),
+        str(state_source.dtype) if state_source is not None else "none",
+        str(checkpoints.dtype),
+        int(device),
+        int(num_sm),
+        DK,
+        DV,
+        int(b_t),
+        bool(split),
+        bool(dt_softplus),
+        dstate_in is not None,
+        dstate0 is not None,
+        transition is not None,
+        skip_bwd_part is not None,
+    )
+    if key not in warmup_backward_cache:
+        bprop_cfg = mamba2_bprop_f16.build_cfg(
+            io_dtype,
+            state_dtype,
+            max_active_clusters=num_sm,
+            use_dstate_in=dstate_in is not None,
+            use_dstate0=dstate0 is not None,
+            dt_softplus=dt_softplus,
+            has_d=d is not None,
+            d_per_channel=d is not None and len(d.shape) == 2,
+            skip_bwd_partials=skip_bwd_part is not None,
+            d_k=DK,
+            d_v=DV,
+        )
+
+        gate_table_placeholder = None
+        dt_bias_table_placeholder = None
+        staging_placeholder = None
+        item_scratch_placeholder = None
+        chunk_scratch_placeholder = None
+        if split:
+            gate_table_placeholder = from_dlpack(gate, assumed_align=8 if facts.gate_elem_bytes == 2 else 4).mark_layout_dynamic(
+                leading_dim=len(gate.shape) - 1
+            )
+            staging_placeholder = from_dlpack(item_scratch, assumed_align=16)
+            staging_placeholder.mark_compact_shape_dynamic(mode=0, stride_order=(0, 1), divisibility=1)
+            item_scratch_placeholder = from_dlpack(item_scratch, assumed_align=4)
+            item_scratch_placeholder.mark_compact_shape_dynamic(mode=0, stride_order=(0, 1), divisibility=1)
+            chunk_scratch_placeholder = from_dlpack(chunk_scratch, assumed_align=4)
+            chunk_scratch_placeholder.mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=1)
+        if dt_bias is not None:
+            dt_bias_table_placeholder = from_dlpack(dt_bias, assumed_align=4)
+            dt_bias_table_placeholder.mark_compact_shape_dynamic(mode=0, stride_order=tuple(range(len(dt_bias.shape))), divisibility=1)
+        work_items_placeholder = from_dlpack(work_items, assumed_align=16)
+        work_items_placeholder.mark_compact_shape_dynamic(mode=0, stride_order=(0, 1), divisibility=1)
+        work_items_table_placeholder = from_dlpack(work_items, assumed_align=4)
+        work_items_table_placeholder.mark_compact_shape_dynamic(mode=0, stride_order=(0, 1), divisibility=1)
+        work_count_table_placeholder = from_dlpack(work_count, assumed_align=4)
+        work_count_table_placeholder.mark_compact_shape_dynamic(mode=0, stride_order=(0,), divisibility=1)
+        dstate_in_placeholder = None
+        if dstate_in is not None:
+            dstate_in_placeholder = from_dlpack(dstate_in, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=3)
+        dstate0_placeholder = None
+        if dstate0 is not None:
+            dstate0_placeholder = from_dlpack(dstate0, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=3)
+        d_placeholder = None
+        if d is not None:
+            d_placeholder = from_dlpack(d, assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=len(d.shape) - 1)
+        warmup_backward_cache[key] = cute.compile(
+            warmup_backward_host,
+            facts.split,
+            facts.b_t,
+            facts.overhead_chunks,
+            facts.warmup_cap,
+            cutlass.Int32(facts.n_heads_out),
+            facts.num_sms,
+            io_dtype,
+            not split,
+            bprop_cfg,
+            cutlass.Int32(facts.n_tiles),
+            cutlass.Int32(facts.ideal_chunks),
+            cutlass.Int32(facts.batch_size),
+            cutlass.Float32(facts.log2_threshold),
+            cutlass.Int32(facts.n_scan_ctas),
+            cutlass.Int32(facts.n_walk_ctas),
+            cutlass.Float32(float(dt_min)),
+            cutlass.Float32(float(dt_max)),
+            from_dlpack(q, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=2),
+            from_dlpack(k, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=2),
+            from_dlpack(v, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=2),
+            from_dlpack(do, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=2),
+            from_dlpack(gate, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=1),
+            gate_table_placeholder,
+            from_dlpack(a, assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(),
+            from_dlpack(a, assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic() if split else None,
+            from_dlpack(dt_bias, assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=len(dt_bias.shape) - 1) if dt_bias is not None else None,
+            dt_bias_table_placeholder,
+            d_placeholder,
+            from_dlpack(dq, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=2),
+            from_dlpack(dk, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=2),
+            from_dlpack(dv, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=2),
+            from_dlpack(checkpoints, assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=3),
+            from_dlpack(exit_dots, assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=1),
+            from_dlpack(skip_bwd_part, assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=len(skip_bwd_part.shape) - 1) if skip_bwd_part is not None else None,
+            from_dlpack(cu_seqlens, assumed_align=8 if str(cu_seqlens.dtype).endswith("int64") else 4).mark_layout_dynamic(),
+            from_dlpack(cu_seqlens, assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(),
+            dstate_in_placeholder,
+            dstate0_placeholder,
+            work_items_placeholder,
+            work_items_table_placeholder,
+            from_dlpack(work_count, assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(),
+            work_count_table_placeholder,
+            staging_placeholder,
+            item_scratch_placeholder,
+            chunk_scratch_placeholder,
+            from_dlpack(scheduler, assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(),
+            from_dlpack(transition, assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=1) if transition is not None else None,
+            from_dlpack(workspace, assumed_align=128).mark_layout_dynamic(),
+            from_dlpack(exit_slots, assumed_align=8).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=1),
+            cuda.CUstream(int(stream)),
+            options="--enable-tvm-ffi --opt-level 2",
+        )
+    compiled = warmup_backward_cache[key]
+    return compiled, facts
+
+
+def run_warmup_backward(
+    compiled,
+    facts,
+    *,
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    do,
+    gate,

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""
+PyTorch custom operator for the Mamba-2 state space duality (SSD) layer.
+
+Mamba-2 is the gated delta rule without the erase term, with one per-token scalar dt
+playing both the decay and the write strength:
+
+    dt_t  = clamp(softplus(dt_raw_t + dt_bias_h), dt_min, dt_max),
+    S_t   = exp(A_h dt_t) S_{t-1} + dt_t B_t^T x_t,
+    y_t   = C_t S_t + D_h x_t              (* z_t sigmoid(z_t) when the z gate is fused),
+
+where ``S_t`` is the recurrent state ``[N, P]`` (``N`` the state dimension, ``P`` the
+head dimension), ``A_h < 0`` a per-head decay rate, ``D`` a per-head or per-channel skip,
+and ``B`` / ``C`` grouped over ``G`` groups of the ``H`` heads.
+
+Layout follows the graph-API MAMBA2 node (THD), token-packed ``[total_tokens, heads, dim]``
+tensors plus ``cu_seqlens`` sequence boundaries.  In the node's vocabulary ``C`` is ``q``,
+``B`` is ``k``, ``x`` is ``v``, ``dt`` is ``g`` and ``A`` is ``a``.
+
+The op is a thin adapter over the graph API; forward and backward execute cached
+single-node ``MAMBA2`` / ``MAMBA2_BWD`` pygraphs.  Engine selection happens at graph
+planning time over the manifest's python engines (``Mamba2FrostEngine`` on
+SM100 / SM103 / SM107).  Registered through ``torch.library.custom_op`` so it composes
+with autograd, ``torch.compile``, and DDP.
+
+Graph caching ensures cuDNN graphs are built once per unique configuration and reused
+across calls.
+"""
+
+from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+import cudnn
+
+from .common import get_handle, graph_workspace, select_plan, torch_dtype_to_cudnn
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Module-level state
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+fprop_cache: Dict[tuple, tuple] = {}
+bprop_cache: Dict[tuple, tuple] = {}
+summary_cache: Dict[tuple, tuple] = {}
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def check_dtype(name, t, want) -> None:
+    wants = want if isinstance(want, tuple) else (want,)
+    if t.dtype not in wants:
+        names = " or ".join(str(w) for w in wants)
+        raise TypeError(f"mamba2: {name} must be {names} (kernel-native; callers convert), got {t.dtype}")
+
+
+def make_fprop_cache_key(
+    total,
+    N,
+    H,
+    G,
+    K,
+    V,
+    io_dtype,
+    cu_dtype,
+    g_dtype,
+    a_dtype,
+    dt_bias_dtype,
+    d_dtype,
+    d_per_channel,
+    z_dtype,
+    state_dtype,
+    output_final_state,
+    output_pre_gate,
+    batch_invariant,
+    checkpoint,
+    dt_softplus,
+    dt_min,
+    dt_max,
+    device,
+    plan_name,
+    overwrite_initial_state,
+    state_pool_rows=None,
+):
+    return (
+        "fprop",
+        total,
+        N,
+        H,
+        G,
+        K,
+        V,
+        io_dtype,
+        cu_dtype,
+        g_dtype,
+        a_dtype,
+        dt_bias_dtype,
+        d_dtype,
+        bool(d_per_channel),
+        z_dtype,
+        state_dtype,
+        bool(output_final_state),
+        bool(output_pre_gate),
+        bool(batch_invariant),
+        checkpoint,
+        bool(dt_softplus),
+        float(dt_min),
+        float(dt_max),
+        device,
+        plan_name,
+        bool(overwrite_initial_state),
+        state_pool_rows,
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Forward graph builder
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def build_fprop_graph(
+    total,
+    N,
+    H,
+    G,
+    K,
+    V,
+    io_dtype,
+    g_dtype,
+    a_dtype,
+    dt_bias_dtype,
+    d_dtype,
+    d_per_channel,
+    z_dtype,
+    state_dtype,
+    cu_dtype,
+    output_final_state,
+    output_pre_gate,
+    batch_invariant,
+    checkpoint,
+    dt_softplus,
+    dt_min,
+    dt_max,
+    overwrite_initial_state=False,
+    state_indices_dtype=None,
+    state_pool_rows=None,
+):
+    graph = cudnn.pygraph()
+    q_t = graph.tensor([total, G, K], data_type=io_dtype, name="q")
+    k_t = graph.tensor([total, G, K], data_type=io_dtype, name="k")
+    v_t = graph.tensor([total, H, V], data_type=io_dtype, name="v")
+    g_t = graph.tensor([total, H], data_type=g_dtype, name="g")
+    a_t = graph.tensor([H], data_type=a_dtype, name="a")
+    cu_t = graph.tensor([N + 1], data_type=cu_dtype, name="cu_seqlens")
+    state0_t = None
+    if state_dtype is not None:
+        state_rows = N if state_pool_rows is None else state_pool_rows
+        state0_t = graph.tensor([state_rows, H, V, K], data_type=state_dtype, name="initial_state")
+    state_indices_t = None
+    if state_indices_dtype is not None:
+        state_indices_t = graph.tensor([N], data_type=state_indices_dtype, name="state_indices")
+    pool_ports = {"state_indices": state_indices_t} if state_indices_t is not None else {}
+    dt_bias_t = None
+    if dt_bias_dtype is not None:
+        dt_bias_t = graph.tensor([H], data_type=dt_bias_dtype, name="dt_bias")
+    d_t = None
+    if d_dtype is not None:
+        d_t = graph.tensor([H, V] if d_per_channel else [H], data_type=d_dtype, name="d")
+    z_t = None
+    if z_dtype is not None:
+        z_t = graph.tensor([total, H, V], data_type=z_dtype, name="z")
+    O_t, fs_t, state_checkpoints_t, o_pre_t = graph.mamba2(
+        q=q_t,
+        k=k_t,
+        v=v_t,
+        g=g_t,
+        a=a_t,
+        cu_seqlens=cu_t,
+        initial_state=state0_t,
+        **pool_ports,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias_t,
+        d=d_t,
+        z=z_t,
+        output_final_state=output_final_state,
+        checkpoint_every_n_tokens=checkpoint,
+        dt_softplus=dt_softplus,
+        dt_min=dt_min,
+        dt_max=None if dt_max == float("inf") else dt_max,
+        output_pre_gate=output_pre_gate or None,
+        batch_invariant=batch_invariant,
+        overwrite_initial_state=overwrite_initial_state or None,
+        name="mamba2",
+    )
+    return graph, dict(
+        q=q_t,
+        k=k_t,
+        v=v_t,
+        g=g_t,
+        a=a_t,
+        cu=cu_t,
+        state0=state0_t,
+        state_indices=state_indices_t,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias_t,
+        d=d_t,
+        z=z_t,
+        O=O_t,
+        fs=fs_t,
+        state_checkpoints=state_checkpoints_t,
+        O_pre=o_pre_t,
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Forward custom op
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def run_mamba2_fwd(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    dt: torch.Tensor,
+    A: torch.Tensor,
+    B: torch.Tensor,
+    C: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    D: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    dt_bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    z: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    initial_state: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    output_final_state: bool = False,
+    output_pre_gate: bool = False,
+    checkpoint_every_n_tokens: int = 0,
+    dt_softplus: bool = True,
+    dt_min: float = 0.0,
+    dt_max: Optional[float] = None,
+    batch_invariant: bool = False,
+    plan_name: Optional[str] = None,
+    final_state_out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    state_indices: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Internal Mamba-2 forward over a cached single-node MAMBA2 pygraph in THD layout.
+
+    Returns ``(y, final_state, state_checkpoints, y_pre)``; ``final_state`` / ``state_checkpoints`` / ``y_pre`` are
+    zero-size tensors when ``output_final_state`` is ``False`` / ``checkpoint_every_n_tokens`` is ``0`` /
+    ``output_pre_gate`` is ``False`` or ``z`` is absent.  ``final_state_out`` binds the final_state output to a caller
+    buffer (the in-place op passes ``initial_state``); ``state_indices`` (int32 ``[N]``) makes ``initial_state`` a
+    pool whose row ``state_indices[i]`` seeds sequence ``i`` and receives its final state.
+    """
+    total, H, V = x.shape
+    G, K = C.shape[1], C.shape[2]
+    if B.shape != C.shape:
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: B and C must share one head count and shape; got {tuple(B.shape)} and {tuple(C.shape)}")
+    if H % G != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: the head count ({H}) must be a multiple of the B / C group count ({G})")
+    if dt.shape != (total, H):
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: dt must be [total_tokens, H] = [{total}, {H}]; got {tuple(dt.shape)}")
+    if A.shape != (H,):
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: A must be [H] = [{H}]; got {tuple(A.shape)}")
+    N = cu_seqlens.shape[0] - 1
+    device = x.device
+    if cu_seqlens.dtype not in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: cu_seqlens must be int32 or int64; got {cu_seqlens.dtype}")
+    check_dtype("dt", dt, (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16, torch.float16))
+    check_dtype("A", A, (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16, torch.float16))
+    if dt_bias is not None:
+        check_dtype("dt_bias", dt_bias, (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16, torch.float16))
+        if dt_bias.shape != (H,):
+            raise ValueError(f"mamba2: dt_bias must be [H] = [{H}]; got {tuple(dt_bias.shape)}")
+    if D is not None:
+        check_dtype("D", D, (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16, torch.float16))
+        if D.shape not in ((H,), (H, V)):
+            raise ValueError(f"mamba2: D must be [H] or [H, P] = [{H}] / [{H}, {V}]; got {tuple(D.shape)}")
+    if z is not None:
+        check_dtype("z", z, x.dtype)
+        if z.shape != x.shape:
+            raise ValueError(f"mamba2: z must match x's shape {tuple(x.shape)}; got {tuple(z.shape)}")
+    dt_max_value = float("inf") if dt_max is None else float(dt_max)
+    if float(dt_min) > dt_max_value:
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: dt_min ({dt_min}) must not exceed dt_max ({dt_max_value})")
+    state_pool_rows = None
+    if state_indices is not None:
+        if initial_state is None:
+            raise ValueError("mamba2: state_indices selects rows of the initial_state pool, so initial_state is required")
+        check_dtype("state_indices", state_indices, torch.int32)
+        if state_indices.dim() != 1 or state_indices.shape[0] != N:
+            raise ValueError(f"mamba2: state_indices must be [N] = [{N}]; got {tuple(state_indices.shape)}")
+        if int(checkpoint_every_n_tokens):
+            raise ValueError("mamba2: state_indices cannot be combined with checkpoint_every_n_tokens")
+        if (
+            tuple(initial_state.stride()[1:]) != (V * K, K, 1)
+            or initial_state.stride(0) < H * V * K
+            or initial_state.stride(0) % (16 // initial_state.element_size())
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("mamba2: state_indices requires a pool whose rows are dense [H, P, N] blocks on a 16-byte aligned slot stride")
+        state_pool_rows = int(initial_state.shape[0])
+    if initial_state is not None:
+        check_dtype("initial_state", initial_state, (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16))
+        if state_indices is None and initial_state.shape[0] != N:
+            raise ValueError(f"initial_state must carry one state per sequence: got {initial_state.shape[0]} for {N} sequences")
+    for tensor_name, tensor in (
+        ("dt", dt),
+        ("A", A),
+        ("B", B),
+        ("C", C),
+        ("cu_seqlens", cu_seqlens),
+        ("D", D),
+        ("dt_bias", dt_bias),
+        ("z", z),
+        ("initial_state", initial_state),
+        ("state_indices", state_indices),
+    ):
+        if tensor is not None and tensor.device != device:
+            raise ValueError(f"mamba2: {tensor_name} must be on x's device ({device}); got {tensor.device}")
+    state0 = initial_state if initial_state is not None else None
+    state_out_dtype = state0.dtype if state0 is not None else torch.float32
+    checkpoint = int(checkpoint_every_n_tokens)
+    want_pre = bool(output_pre_gate) and z is not None
+    cache_key = make_fprop_cache_key(
+        total,
+        N,
+        H,
+        G,
+        K,
+        V,
+        x.dtype,
+        cu_seqlens.dtype,
+        dt.dtype,
+        A.dtype,
+        dt_bias.dtype if dt_bias is not None else None,
+        D.dtype if D is not None else None,
+        D is not None and D.dim() == 2,
+        z.dtype if z is not None else None,
+        state0.dtype if state0 is not None else None,
+        output_final_state,
+        want_pre,
+        batch_invariant,
+        checkpoint,
+        dt_softplus,
+        dt_min,
+        dt_max_value,
+        device,
+        plan_name,
+        final_state_out is not None,
+        state_pool_rows,
+    )
+    if cache_key not in fprop_cache:
+        fprop_cache[cache_key] = build_fprop_graph(
+            total,
+            N,
+            H,
+            G,
+            K,
+            V,
+            torch_dtype_to_cudnn(x.dtype),
+            torch_dtype_to_cudnn(dt.dtype),
+            torch_dtype_to_cudnn(A.dtype),
+            torch_dtype_to_cudnn(dt_bias.dtype) if dt_bias is not None else None,
+            torch_dtype_to_cudnn(D.dtype) if D is not None else None,
+            D is not None and D.dim() == 2,
+            torch_dtype_to_cudnn(z.dtype) if z is not None else None,
+            torch_dtype_to_cudnn(state0.dtype) if state0 is not None else None,
+            torch_dtype_to_cudnn(cu_seqlens.dtype),
+            bool(output_final_state),
+            want_pre,
+            bool(batch_invariant),
+            checkpoint,
+            bool(dt_softplus),
+            float(dt_min),
+            dt_max_value,
+            overwrite_initial_state=final_state_out is not None,
+            state_indices_dtype=torch_dtype_to_cudnn(state_indices.dtype) if state_indices is not None else None,
+            state_pool_rows=state_pool_rows,
+        )
+        select_plan(fprop_cache[cache_key][0], plan_name)
+
+    graph, t = fprop_cache[cache_key]
+
+    y = torch.empty(total, H, V, dtype=x.dtype, device=device)
+    variant_pack = {
+        t["q"]: C,
+        t["k"]: B,
+        t["v"]: x,
+        t["g"]: dt,
+        t["a"]: A,
+        t["cu"]: cu_seqlens,
+        t["O"]: y,
+    }
+    if state0 is not None:
+        variant_pack[t["state0"]] = state0
+    if state_indices is not None:
+        variant_pack[t["state_indices"]] = state_indices
+    if dt_bias is not None:
+        variant_pack[t["dt_bias"]] = dt_bias
+    if D is not None:
+        variant_pack[t["d"]] = D
+    if z is not None:
+        variant_pack[t["z"]] = z
+    final_state = torch.empty(0, dtype=state_out_dtype, device=device)
+    if final_state_out is not None:
+        final_state = final_state_out
+        variant_pack[t["fs"]] = final_state
+    elif output_final_state:
+        final_state = torch.empty(N, H, V, K, dtype=state_out_dtype, device=device)
+        variant_pack[t["fs"]] = final_state
+    state_checkpoints = torch.empty(0, dtype=x.dtype, device=device)
+    if checkpoint > 0:
+        total_checkpoints = max(total // checkpoint + N, 1)
+        state_checkpoints = torch.empty(total_checkpoints, H, V, K, dtype=x.dtype, device=device)
+        variant_pack[t["state_checkpoints"]] = state_checkpoints
+    y_pre = torch.empty(0, dtype=x.dtype, device=device)
+    if want_pre:
+        y_pre = torch.empty(total, H, V, dtype=x.dtype, device=device)
+        variant_pack[t["O_pre"]] = y_pre
+    graph.execute(variant_pack, workspace=graph_workspace(graph, device), handle=get_handle(device))
+    return y, final_state, state_checkpoints, y_pre

+def make_bprop_cache_key(*parts):
+    return tuple(parts)
